postTitle: Stop causing layout shifts with CSS-in-JS
postContent:
If you are building a custom CSS-in-JS library or a dynamic styling system, you probably know the struggle of style injection.

Injecting styles during useEffect or useLayoutEffect causes a performance bottleneck. Why? Because it forces the browser to recalculate styles and layout repeatedly, leading to visible flickers or 'layout shift'.

This is where useInsertionEffect comes in.

It is a specialized hook that fires BEFORE useLayoutEffect and useEffect. It allows you to inject styles into the DOM before React even calculates where elements should go on the screen.

Key takeaways:
- It only runs once during the initial mount (or when dependencies change).
- It does not have access to refs (since they aren't attached yet).
- It is strictly for injecting styles, not for manipulating the DOM or state.

tehnicalChallange.title: Build a Dynamic Theme Injector
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a component that accepts a 'themeColor' prop and uses useInsertionEffect to inject a global CSS variable (--theme-color) into the document head.
